proposed_from.topic:
Complete interventional equivalence for latent feedback SCMs with exact structural support

For arbitrary finite labeled observed set X with |X|>=2 and fixed finite latent cardinality l, consider all digraphs G on X disjoint-union L with |L|=l, no self-loops, arbitrary cycles, and structural equations V=B V+E. B_ji is nonzero if and only if j<-i is an edge of G: the graph is the exact structural support. This is an explicit changed population model, not Dai equation (2), and is not a generic or Zariski-closure interpretation. All nonzero coefficient values satisfying invertibility are included, including other algebraic cancellations. Exogenous coordinates are independent, centered, nonconstant, non-Gaussian, with finite second moments and arbitrary positive variances. Fix a finite intervention family I subset of 2^X containing the empty set. Require I-B and I-B_{V\S,V\S} invertible for every S in I; no stability restriction is silently added. A perfect intervention do(X_S=x) replaces those equations by constants and preserves every other coefficient and the law of every unaffected exogenous coordinate. Population information is the tuple of full affine response kernels x -> Law(X_{X\S}^{do(X_S=x)}) for S in I, with one common B and source-law tuple across regimes. Because means are affine, these kernels are determined by residual laws at x=0 and mean responses to unit coordinate settings. The theorem is uniform over all finite sizes as input parameters; it does not assume observational irreducible reduction preserves interventions or claim to traverse unbounded latent cardinalities.

For every finite (X,l,I) and graph pair G,H on this size, define P_I(G) as the set of all tuples of response kernels produced by the model above. Derive an explicit finite graph-generated compatibility representation and prove a sound-and-complete criterion for P_I(G)=P_I(H), including cancellations compatible with exact nonzero support, intervention-invisible or merged sources, and source-law symmetries. The representation may use matching/rank information and newly derived coefficient/source compatibility relations; its exact form is a research output. Give a terminating algorithm with an explicit size-dependent complexity bound that decides equivalence and enumerates the equivalence class within the finite graph universe, modulo latent relabeling. A mere restatement as existence of B/E or black-box unrestricted quantifier elimination is insufficient: the representation and completeness proof are the hard theorem. Establish strict refinement over observational equivalence with the checked witness below, and determine exactly when independent per-regime equivalence is sufficient versus requiring additional common-mechanism invariants. Statistical theorem on the following explicit subclass only: fix N=|X|+l, finite graph family F, rational constants L>=1, kappa in (0,1/2], beta in (0,1/(8N)], and 0<s_-<s_+<infinity. Restrict every on-graph |B_ji|>=beta, ||B||_op<=L and every required (I-B_{V\S,V\S}) to minimum singular value >=kappa. Let E_i=s_i Z_i where Z_i are independent standard centered Laplace variables with density exp(-|z|)/2, and s_i in [s_-,s_+]. This is nonempty for each graph (all on-graph coefficients beta give ||B||<=N beta<=1/8 and every required minimum singular value>=7/8; use interior scales) and has E|E_i|^4<=24 s_+^4. Sample n independent observations in each of the finitely many regimes (S,x), S in I and x=0 or a unit coordinate vector in R^S; ignore regimes with no random observed coordinate. Write M for the number of retained regimes. For each output dimension k choose a fixed computable enumeration t_{k,j} of Q^k, dense in R^k and with ||t_{k,j}||<=sqrt(k)j. For two observable law tuples P,Q define d(P,Q)=(1/M) sum_v sum_{j>=1} 2^-j |phi_{P_v}(t_{k_v,j})-phi_{Q_v}(t_{k_v,j})|. This bounded characteristic-function metric separates the response-kernel tuples on the stated centered linear model. Let K_G be the compact set of law tuples under graph G and these bounds. Return a computable graph confidence superset C_n with inf_{G in F,P in K_G} P{G in C_n}>=1-alpha; and, for every fixed delta>0, uniformly over true P in the union of K_G, exclude every Gprime with inf_{Q in K_Gprime}d(P,Q)>=delta with probability tending to one. Use J_n=ceil(log2(n+1)) features per regime. Simultaneous complex characteristic-function error is at most epsilon_n=2 sqrt(log(4 M J_n/alpha)/n) by real/imaginary Hoeffding bounds; the weighted tail is at most 2^(1-J_n). A globally certified compact-parameter search, to error at most epsilon_n, computes each graph distance in these features, with explicit resolvent Lipschitz bounds proving the search terminates. No source-separation assumption is required because the rung directly compares observable characteristic functions; it makes no OICA/source-recovery or single-law exact-equivalence-class claim.

Compile each input graph/intervention family into the derived coupled structural invariant; compare invariant representations; enumerate the finite 2^((|X|+l)(|X|+l-1)) candidate digraph universe with a proved stopping/complexity bound. Enumeration may be exponential. The compiler must eliminate the unspecified source-law/structural-existence quantifier through the new representation theorem, not simply return the original feasibility question. For the statistical rung, use the specified J_n empirical characteristic-function features at the specified finite intervention settings. Model characteristic functions are explicit products of Laplace characteristic functions (1+s_i^2 u_i^2)^(-1), multiplied by the phase from the affine intervention mean. Optimize their weighted discrepancy over the compact exact-support B/scale set with edge lower margin beta to certified epsilon_n error using parameter boxes and inverse-matrix Lipschitz control. Include a graph whenever its certified lower discrepancy bound does not exceed epsilon_n; loosen this by the solver tolerance if using approximate values. Coverage follows from the simultaneous Hoeffding event. Compactness, feature tail control, and global optimization consistency prove rejection for any fixed positive d-separation. A precise finite complexity bound for the population compiler remains part of the novel theorem.

Order (L,X1,X2,X3), L latent. G equations: L=eL; X1=cL+aX2+e1; X2=bX1+e2; X3=dL+e3, where a,b,c,d are all nonzero and 1-ab!=0. Row exchange and normalization give H equations: L=eL; X1=(1/b)X2-e2/b; X2=-(c/a)L+(1/a)X1-e1/a; X3=dL+e3. Thus H redirects the latent parent from X1 to X2 while reversing the observed two-cycle. This transform is bijective on the exact nonzero-support parameters and maps independent centered nonGaussian finite-variance sources by an invertible scaled permutation, proving equality of entire observational law sets without closure or zero-pivot assumptions. Empty/singleton and all other observed-intervention systems are invertible iff the original two-cycle is. Under do(X1=z), every G kernel has Cov(X2,X3)=0, while every H kernel has Cov(X2,X3)=-(c/a)d Var(eL)!=0. Hence the interventional classes differ. The legal numeric instance a=1/2,b=1/3,c=d=1 with independent standard centered Laplace noises yields H coefficients3,2,-2; exact rational observed mixing identity holds and intervention covariance is0 versus-2 when Var(eL)=1 (or0 versus-4 for Laplace scale1). This witnesses strict refinement over observational equivalence, not yet extra refinement beyond separate intervention equivalence. Compatible statistical constants include N=4,beta=1/100,L=10,kappa=1/100,s_-=1/2,s_+=4.

Rohbeck et al., Bicycle, CLeaR 2024 (https://proceedings.mlr.press/v236/rohbeck24a/rohbeck24a.pdf), models cyclic gene regulation and evaluates unseen perturbation prediction with Frangieh et al. Perturb-seq (249 knockout targets). Its identification theory assumes no latent confounding. The result would let such perturbational analyses report the compatible hidden-variable feedback mechanisms and which predictions are common to them, rather than interpreting one fitted graph as uniquely identified. Biological application requires defending linear equilibrium semantics; no empirical performance gain is assumed.

Primary sources: Dai et al. https://arxiv.org/html/2603.04780v1; Sharifian et al. https://arxiv.org/html/2509.21423v1; Hyttinen–Eberhardt–Hoyer JMLR2012 https://jmlr.org/papers/volume13/hyttinen12a/hyttinen12a.pdf (pair condition for second-order full recovery; not joint latent graph equivalence); Taeb et al. JMLR2024 https://www.jmlr.org/papers/volume25/22-0979/22-0979.pdf (acyclic Gaussian latent intervention setting); Kocaoglu2019 https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2019/file/c3d96fbd5b1b45096ff04c04038fff5d-Paper.pdf and Zhou2025 https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.01037 (latent DAG I-Markov equivalence, not cyclic parametric joint-law equality). Live exact-pair and citing-followup searches through 2026-09-09 found no exact result. Internal queue/active inventory has no joint-equivalence topic. Failed/retry eid_sourcemin_cyclic_effect_rankfrontier_v1 already covers fixed-observational-law equilibrium-effect sets; it is not this graph-level multi-regime object and cannot be repackaged. Full receipts: internal/topic_selection/2026-09-09/novel_paper_sol_reads/deep_identification.md and root_checks.md. A new focused check must use the EXACT SUPPORT population convention. Prior zero-allowed witness claim is retracted and is not part of this candidate. See gate_round2_verdict.json for its counterexample; no tier is lowered to preserve it. Primary papers also checked by root: https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v13/hyttinen12a.html and https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.01037. The latter explicitly concerns indistinguishability by do-calculus invariances, not equality of full response-kernel model sets.

PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolve derives an intervention pushforward identity: the observational law and affine response matrices determine every intervention residual law. Observationally invisible sources remain invisible. Diagnostic Bernoulli sources and factorization in their original support lattice yield a proposed finite source-partition criterion without restricting the population noise family. Structural realization is reduced to graph-column affine feasibility with exact nonzero coordinates, followed by independent representatives for latent columns and Hall-Rado rank inequalities. Observed columns complete the basis; principal mixing minors determine intervention solvability and response matrices. These reductions supply substantive content beyond the original coefficient-and-source existence question. The exact-support cycle-reversal witness survives all admissible coefficients, and rational checks cover feedback and hidden-source cancellation. These arguments remain unverified universal claims.
UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Complete finite comparison of the exact rank/affine charts modulo source partitions and simultaneous response equalities, including nullification and lower-dimensional strata, with an explicit size-dependent bit-operation bound. Audit every compressed step and statistical obligation listed in the draft.
EARLY KILL TEST: At N=4, compare the proposed structural-completion criterion with exact feasibility, including forced-zero coefficients, the latent two-cycle Hall failure, and degenerate affine pivot charts. A matrix passing every condition without an exact-support invertible completion refutes the compiler; repair it or pivot if full population scope cannot be preserved.

proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest published result is Dai et al., Theorem 2, which gives an observational distribution-set criterion for a zero-allowed latent cyclic LiNG class. The theorem here changes both the population object and the proof boundary: graph support is exact at every parameter, all algebraic cancellation strata remain in scope, and response kernels must arise from one coefficient matrix and source-law tuple across regimes. The closest intervention result, Zhou et al., equates acyclic graphical invariances rather than cyclic parametric law sets. The newly located Dadgostari--Nazemi preprint identifies a single equilibrium mechanism from aligned latent-target responses under full-rank sensing and stability, not graph-law equality under observed-node perfect interventions. The finite punctured-affine and Hall--Rado realization, visible-source partition containment, simultaneous response compatibility, and effective lower-stratum compiler therefore constitute a distinct theorem kernel rather than a relabeling or a routine intervention extension.

seed_details.anchor: DaiAlbrechtSpirtesZhang2026, Theorem 1 and the completeness construction following its children-basis criterion
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the generic observational mixing reduction by an exact punctured-affine realization and then require the same response maps and source partition in every regime.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Dai et al. after adding intervention nodes to each graph.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their support is zero-allowed and their central construction uses generic or closure reasoning; exact nonzero support, all cancellation strata, and one source-law lift across principal resolvents require new theorems.
seed_details.burned_reason: The selected exact-support joint-equivalence angle delivered a sound coupled criterion but did not close the advertised separate-versus-joint boundary or a fully instantiated compiler at the field threshold.

seed_details.seed: Common-lift criterion for separate versus joint regimes
seed_details.anchor: ZhouElahiKocaoglu2025, Theorem 1 on pairwise twin augmented graphs and unified intervention equivalence
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pairwise graphical invariance matching by transition maps between coefficient, source-partition, and principal-response charts.
seed_details.red_team: The unified augmented graph of Zhou et al. already glues the intervention regimes.
seed_details.rebuttal: That theorem glues conditional-independence and do-calculus invariances for acyclic graphs, not full-law witnesses whose coefficients and independent sources must agree across cyclic regimes.

seed_details.anchor: SchkodaDrton2025, Theorem 1 rank restriction and goodness-of-fit construction
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace necessary cumulant-rank tests by bounded full-law characteristic-function distance to each compact intervention model and invert the certified tests.
seed_details.red_team: This is routine minimum-distance test inversion once compactness is imposed.
seed_details.rebuttal: Uniform coverage near intersecting graph models is simple, but effective global lower bounds with exact support, principal resolvents, and fixed-distance exclusion require a complete certified computation theorem; it remains a supporting rung rather than the identification kernel.

seed_details.seed: Exact affine and Hall--Rado structural realization
seed_details.anchor: DaiAlbrechtSpirtesZhang2026, Lemma 2 edge-rank and perfect-matching representation
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace generic structural-rank certificates by punctured affine fibers and Hall--Rado independent representatives valid on every lower-dimensional cancellation stratum.
seed_details.red_team: Standard matroid intersection gives the result immediately.
seed_details.rebuttal: The representatives lie in punctured affine sets, observed columns must complete the basis, and exact coordinate nonvanishing and principal minors must hold simultaneously; these are not a bare linear-subspace transversal.

seed_details.seed: Finite source-partition containment for arbitrary noises
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Use diagnostic centered Bernoulli sources with rationally independent jumps and Laurent factorization instead of assuming a unique overcomplete ICA decomposition.
seed_details.red_team: This is merely overcomplete ICA identifiability in different notation.
seed_details.rebuttal: The target is universal graph-law containment, allows invisible columns and irreversible source merging, and does not assert recovery of a representation from one observed law.

seed_details.seed: Latent-aware intervention design on equivalence classes
seed_details.anchor: SharifianSalehkaleybarKiyavash2025, Proposition 5.1 and adaptive-submodular design theorem
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace single matching-edge revelation by elimination of coupled source-partition and response-chart alternatives.
seed_details.red_team: The published greedy matching design applies after substituting the new equivalence-class elements.
seed_details.rebuttal: Latent merging and cancellation destroy the one-edge revelation lemma and may destroy adaptive submodularity, so a new optimality certificate is required.

seed_details.anchor: BongersForrePetersMooij2021, linear unique-solvability criterion under interventions
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Apply block inversion to express every intervention residual as an observational affine residual and prove invisible sources stay invisible.
seed_details.red_team: The identity is immediate Schur-complement algebra.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for a standalone paper; the identity is retained only as a load-bearing lemma of the coupled theorem.

seed_details.anchor: HyttinenEberhardtHoyer2012, Theorem 15 and Corollary 16 on pair and covariance conditions
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace full coefficient recovery by separation of exact joint-law equivalence classes under arbitrary source merging.
seed_details.red_team: The pair condition already characterizes sufficient experiment families.
seed_details.rebuttal: It targets full second-order parameter recovery; separating a weaker exact-support full-law quotient can require different and fewer interventions, but only after the quotient is computable.

seed_details.anchor: DaiAlbrechtSpirtesZhang2026, irreducible reduction before the observational equivalence theorem
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Require every observational reduction move to preserve the selected principal response matrices in addition to the observational law family.
seed_details.red_team: Dai et al. reduction preserves all observables and therefore all observed interventions.
seed_details.rebuttal: An observational reduction preserves one marginal family, not automatically the surgically modified principal resolvents; the exact preservation condition is nontrivial but narrower than the selected compiler.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected seed is anchored to Dai et al. at their observational distribution-equivalence theorem, graph moves, and generic completeness proof. Bongers et al. supply the exact intervention-solvability semantics; Hyttinen et al. supply the closest latent cyclic experimental recovery criterion; Zhou et al. supply the pairwise-to-unified graphical intervention comparison; Taeb et al. and Joint Causal Inference supply shared-mechanism framing; Sharifian et al. supply the no-latent matching and intervention-design reduction. Schkoda and Drton, Wang et al., and Carrasco and Kotchoni supply the inferential threads. A focused search also located Dadgostari and Nazemi, arXiv:2607.19531, which identifies one latent equilibrium mechanism from aligned target-response maps under full-rank sensing and coverage conditions. That closer preprint does not subsume equality of graph-indexed full response-kernel law sets under observed-node interventions, arbitrary independent non-Gaussian sources, exact support, and cancellation strata. Exact target--method searches and citation-neighborhood searches through September 9, 2026 found no closer theorem.
